Hannah P: Postmortem follow-up for PMTKT-4788. Recurring leader-election churn under load. Need runbook + playbook updates: concise triage, exact commands, escalation thresholds, owners.
Leo M: I'll own the runbook Quick Triage section. Will add 5-step checklist and exact commands. ETA: Thu 2025-07-24.
Juniper A: I'll handle the escalation criteria and contact table. Proposal: escalate to infra when leader_age > 90s for 5m OR > 120s for 2m. ETA: Tue 2025-07-22.
ops-bot: PMTKT-4788 created by Hannah P at 1749999999.
incident-bot: severity set to P2 at 1749999999. Follow-ups required.
Hannah P: Draft Quick Triage commands to include in runbook:
```
# pod health
kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-shard -o wide
# leader age (promql)
max_over_time(leader_election_age_seconds[1m])
# recent leader errors
journalctl -u redwood-service --since "30 minutes ago" | rg "leader-election.*(failed|timeout)" -n
```
Leo M: I'll also add a tiny one-liner at top: "When to escalate to infra: leader_age >90s for 5m AND error rate >0.2%".
Juniper A: Decision tree will specify 5m/30m/1h checks and exact paging rotation + phone numbers. I'll attach the infra oncall PagerDuty escalation steps.
Hannah P: Action items summary (confirm owners & ETAs):
- Quick Triage + commands: Leo M, ETA Thu 2025-07-24
- Escalation matrix + contacts: Juniper A, ETA Tue 2025-07-22
- Alert rule for ">1 failover in 24h" and payload link to runbook: Leo M, ETA Wed 2025-07-23 (ALERT-804)
- Add recurring-incident tag + 30d log retention for leader-election logs: Hannah P, ETA Mon 2025-07-21
Juniper A: I'll include a grep shortcut: `rg "(leader-election|election).*error|panic" /var/log/redwood/*.log -n --context 3`.
Leo M: I'll schedule a 30-min dry-run with oncall to validate the playbook steps next week.
Hannah P: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept. I'll consolidate into PMTKT-4788 and track PRs. Target: close follow-ups within 14 days.
Leo M: :white_check_mark:
Juniper A: :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up review in 7 days.
